description: A friendly monitoring dashboard for websites, services, and status pages.
data_storage: Local Store managed folder / uptime-kuma / data
risk_notes: Creates a Docker container named local-store-uptime-kuma.
Publishes port 3001 on this computer's loopback interface only.
Stores the SQLite database and uploaded assets in the Local Store app directory.
Monitoring private network services may reveal their addresses inside Uptime Kuma's database.
compose:
services:
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:2.5.3@sha256:3e24e96c89efff0e3a4b0698cbdd36c15ad3022371db57166e5588853002ee5c
    container_name: local-store-uptime-kuma
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data
    mem_limit: 536870912
    cpus: "2.000"
    pids_limit: 512

resource_limits.reason: Managed-engine launch task measured 165884723 bytes at peak for this service. The 512 MiB development ceiling allows headroom and bounds runaway work; larger workloads require separate sizing.
